import_permit_required.quote: An entry permit from the Department of Plant Industry, Clemson University, is required before moving bees or fixtures into this State.

import_certificate_of_inspection_require.quote: All bees and fixtures shipped or moved into this State must be accompanied by a certificate of inspection signed by the state entomologist, state apiary inspector, or corresponding official of the state or country from which the bees are shipped or moved.

import_certificate_validity_days.quote: must be based upon an actual inspection of the bees and fixtures themselves within sixty days preceding the date of shipment

africanized_bee_regulated.quote: "Disease" means contagious and infectious disease, including, but not limited to, American Foulbrood, European Foulbrood, Isle of Wight disease, or any pests and parasites, including, but not limited to, Varroa Mite, Tracheal mite, Africanized bee, etc.

regulated_diseases.quote: "Disease" means contagious and infectious disease, including, but not limited to, American Foulbrood, European Foulbrood, Isle of Wight disease, or any pests and parasites, including, but not limited to, Varroa Mite, Tracheal mite, Africanized bee, etc.

right_of_entry_scope.quote: The division may enter a warehouse, premises, or area to inspect bees and beekeeping fixtures to determine if they (a) are infected with a disease or (b) have been or are being transported in violation of the provisions of this chapter.

transfer_permit_required_for_diseased_eq.quote: The shipment or movement into this State of any used or secondhand fixtures is prohibited unless permitted by regulations of the division.
